workflow: A build configuration probes whether a platform-dependent interface is available using target settings that differ from the eventual compilation settings.
The probe reports the interface as available and enables code paths that depend on it.
Compilation runs under a target environment whose headers do not declare that interface.
Strict compiler diagnostics reject the undeclared use, so the build fails instead of selecting a compatible fallback or reporting the target mismatch clearly.
summary: Mismatched capability probe enables unavailable interface
decision_reason: The failure is a configuration-versus-compilation target mismatch causing a false capability result. No existing cluster captures this specific probe inconsistency and downstream undeclared-interface build failure.
